paragraphs.text: Commander-General Lannos Nodov was a Commander-General of the Wojek League on Ravnica in 10012 ZC.

He was present in the halls of Prahv during Feather 's trial after her return from Agyrem as a Boros representative. When the Parhelion crashed into Prahv, Nodov was almost completely obliterated by a fallen hunk of stone from the ceiling. Only one leg remained.
